    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">基于yolo12对目标物体进行自动裁剪和模糊打码</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202509/3687401-20250909095842474-1299365693.png" alt="基于yolo12对目标物体进行自动裁剪和模糊打码" class="desc_img">
        该视频处理工具基于YOLO12模型实现目标物体的自动裁剪和模糊打码功能。文章详细解析了其核心代码逻辑，包括VideoProcessor类负责视频处理（加载、检测、裁剪、模糊）和VideoPlayer类实现用户界面交互。工具采用Ultralytics框架调用YOLO12n预训练模型，支持实时处理视频流并保存结果，具有高效的目标检测能力和灵活的功能切换。系统通过模块化设计分离处理逻辑与界面控制，提供直观的操作体验，适用于隐私保护等场景。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span data-cke-copybin-start="1">​</span></p>
<h2 id="%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E6%BC%94%E7%A4%BA">视频演示</h2>
<p><a href="https://www.bilibili.com/video/BV1TFafz3EHz/" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">基于yolo12对目标物体进行自动裁剪和模糊打码</a></p>
<hr id="hr-toc">
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2 id="%E5%BC%95%E8%A8%80">引言</h2>
<p>本篇文章将深入剖析一个基于 YOLO12 模型的视频处理工具的代码实现逻辑与核心功能。该工具能够对视频中的目标物体（如行李箱）进行自动裁剪和模糊打码处理，适用于隐私保护、目标提取等场景。我们将重点讲解代码的核心逻辑、YOLO12 模型的应用以及实现效果，简要提及工具的使用方式。</p>
<p><img alt="gif" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202509/3687401-20250909095701015-1261382756.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="主界面" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202509/3687401-20250909095736656-296191858.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<hr>
<h2 id="%E6%A0%B8%E5%BF%83%E5%8A%9F%E8%83%BD%E4%B8%8E%E6%95%88%E6%9E%9C">核心功能与效果</h2>
<p>该工具通过 <strong>Ultralytics YOLO</strong> 框架，利用 YOLO12 模型实现以下核心功能：</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>目标物体裁剪</strong>：自动检测视频中的目标物体（例如行李箱），并将其裁剪为单独的图片保存。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>目标物体模糊</strong>：对检测到的目标物体区域进行模糊打码处理，并在模糊区域显示物体类别和置信度。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>实时处理与保存</strong>：支持实时处理视频流，保存裁剪图片和处理后的视频。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>效果展示：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>输入</strong>：一段机场传送带运输行李箱的视频。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>输出</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>裁剪后的行李箱图片，保存至指定目录。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>模糊打码后的视频，行李箱区域被模糊处理，并标注类别和置信度。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>用户可通过界面控制播放、暂停和保存操作。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="裁剪效果" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202509/3687401-20250909095806333-1983177076.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<hr>
<h2 id="%E4%BB%A3%E7%A0%81%E5%AE%9E%E7%8E%B0%E9%80%BB%E8%BE%91">代码实现逻辑</h2>
<p>工具的核心代码分为两个主要类：VideoProcessor（负责视频处理逻辑）和 VideoPlayer（负责用户界面和交互）。以下从逻辑和实现的角度详细分析。</p>
<h3 id="1.%20VideoProcessor%20%E7%B1%BB%EF%BC%9A%E6%A0%B8%E5%BF%83%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E9%80%BB%E8%BE%91">1. VideoProcessor 类：核心处理逻辑</h3>
<p>VideoProcessor 类封装了视频加载、帧处理和结果保存的逻辑，基于 YOLO12 模型实现目标检测、裁剪和模糊功能。</p>
<h4 id="1.1%20%E5%88%9D%E5%A7%8B%E5%8C%96%E4%B8%8E%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%E9%85%8D%E7%BD%AE">1.1 初始化与模型配置</h4>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="6" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22def%20__init__(self)%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.cap%20%3D%20None%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.current_frame%20%3D%20None%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.output_dir%20%3D%20%5C%22output%5C%22%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.crop_enabled%20%3D%20False%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.blur_enabled%20%3D%20False%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.processed_frames%20%3D%20%5B%5D%5Cn%20%20%20%20%23%20%E5%88%9D%E5%A7%8B%E5%8C%96%20YOLOv12%20%E6%A8%A1%E5%9E%8B%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.cropper%20%3D%20solutions.ObjectCropper(model%3D%5C%22yolo12n.pt%5C%22%2C%20show%3DFalse)%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.blurrer%20%3D%20solutions.ObjectBlurrer(model%3D%5C%22yolo12n.pt%5C%22%2C%20show%3DFalse)%5Cn%20%20%20%20if%20not%20os.path.exists(self.output_dir)%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20os.makedirs(self.output_dir)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>def __init__(self):
    self.cap = None
    self.current_frame = None
    self.output_dir = "output"
    self.crop_enabled = False
    self.blur_enabled = False
    self.processed_frames = []
    # 初始化 YOLOv12 模型
    self.cropper = solutions.ObjectCropper(model="yolo12n.pt", show=False)
    self.blurrer = solutions.ObjectBlurrer(model="yolo12n.pt", show=False)
    if not os.path.exists(self.output_dir):
        os.makedirs(self.output_dir)</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>YOLO12 模型</strong>：使用 Ultralytics 的 solutions 模块，初始化 ObjectCropper 和 ObjectBlurrer 两个对象，分别用于裁剪和模糊处理，均基于预训练模型 yolo12n.pt。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>输出目录</strong>：默认创建 output 目录，用于保存裁剪图片和处理后的视频。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>状态管理</strong>：通过 crop_enabled 和 blur_enabled 控制是否启用裁剪或模糊功能。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="1.2%20%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E5%8A%A0%E8%BD%BD%E4%B8%8E%E5%B8%A7%E8%8E%B7%E5%8F%96">1.2 视频加载与帧获取</h4>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="5" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22def%20load_video(self%2C%20video_path)%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20if%20self.cap%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20self.cap.release()%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.cap%20%3D%20cv2.VideoCapture(video_path)%5Cn%20%20%20%20return%20self.cap.isOpened()%5Cn%5Cndef%20get_frame(self)%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20if%20self.cap%20and%20self.cap.isOpened()%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20ret%2C%20frame%20%3D%20self.cap.read()%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20if%20ret%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20self.current_frame%20%3D%20frame%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20return%20frame%5Cn%20%20%20%20return%20None%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>def load_video(self, video_path):
    if self.cap:
        self.cap.release()
    self.cap = cv2.VideoCapture(video_path)
    return self.cap.isOpened()

def get_frame(self):
    if self.cap and self.cap.isOpened():
        ret, frame = self.cap.read()
        if ret:
            self.current_frame = frame
            return frame
    return None</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>视频加载</strong>：使用 OpenCV 的 cv2.VideoCapture 加载视频文件，确保视频有效性。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>帧获取</strong>：逐帧读取视频，保存当前帧到 current_frame。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="1.3%20%E5%B8%A7%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%EF%BC%88%E8%A3%81%E5%89%AA%E4%B8%8E%E6%A8%A1%E7%B3%8A%EF%BC%89">1.3 帧处理（裁剪与模糊）</h4>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="4" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22def%20process_frame(self%2C%20frame)%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20processed%20%3D%20frame.copy()%5Cn%20%20%20%20if%20self.crop_enabled%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20results%20%3D%20self.cropper(frame)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20processed%20%3D%20results.plot_im%20if%20hasattr(results%2C%20'plot_im')%20else%20processed%5Cn%20%20%20%20if%20self.blur_enabled%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20results%20%3D%20self.blurrer(frame)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20processed%20%3D%20results.plot_im%20if%20hasattr(results%2C%20'plot_im')%20else%20processed%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.processed_frames.append(processed)%5Cn%20%20%20%20return%20processed%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>def process_frame(self, frame):
    processed = frame.copy()
    if self.crop_enabled:
        results = self.cropper(frame)
        processed = results.plot_im if hasattr(results, 'plot_im') else processed
    if self.blur_enabled:
        results = self.blurrer(frame)
        processed = results.plot_im if hasattr(results, 'plot_im') else processed
    self.processed_frames.append(processed)
    return processed</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>核心逻辑</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>裁剪</strong>：调用 ObjectCropper 处理视频帧，自动检测目标物体并裁剪，保存裁剪结果到 output 目录。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>模糊</strong>：调用 ObjectBlurrer 对目标物体区域进行模糊处理，标注类别和置信度。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>结果存储</strong>：处理后的帧存储在 processed_frames 列表中，用于后续视频保存。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>灵活性</strong>：通过 crop_enabled 和 blur_enabled 动态控制是否应用裁剪或模糊。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="1.4%20%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E7%BB%93%E6%9E%9C">1.4 保存处理结果</h4>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="3" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22def%20save_frame(self%2C%20frame%2C%20filename)%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20filepath%20%3D%20os.path.join(self.output_dir%2C%20filename)%5Cn%20%20%20%20cv2.imwrite(filepath%2C%20frame)%5Cn%20%20%20%20return%20filepath%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>def save_frame(self, frame, filename):
    filepath = os.path.join(self.output_dir, filename)
    cv2.imwrite(filepath, frame)
    return filepath</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>裁剪图片保存</strong>：将裁剪后的图片保存到指定目录。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>视频保存</strong>（在 VideoPlayer 中实现，见下文）。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3 id="2.%20VideoPlayer%20%E7%B1%BB%EF%BC%9A%E7%94%A8%E6%88%B7%E7%95%8C%E9%9D%A2%E4%B8%8E%E4%BA%A4%E4%BA%92">2. VideoPlayer 类：用户界面与交互</h3>
<p>VideoPlayer 类基于 PyQt5 实现图形界面，负责视频显示、用户交互和处理控制。</p>
<h4 id="2.1%20%E7%95%8C%E9%9D%A2%E5%88%9D%E5%A7%8B%E5%8C%96">2.1 界面初始化</h4>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="2" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22def%20init_ui(self)%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20central_widget%20%3D%20QWidget()%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.setCentralWidget(central_widget)%5Cn%20%20%20%20main_layout%20%3D%20QHBoxLayout(central_widget)%5Cn%20%20%20%20left_panel%20%3D%20QVBoxLayout()%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.video_label%20%3D%20QLabel()%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.video_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.video_label.setMinimumSize(640%2C%20480)%5Cn%20%20%20%20left_panel.addWidget(self.video_label)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%23%20%E6%8E%A7%E5%88%B6%E6%8C%89%E9%92%AE%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.select_btn%20%3D%20QPushButton(%5C%22%E9%80%89%E6%8B%A9%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%5C%22)%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.play_btn%20%3D%20QPushButton(%5C%22%E6%92%AD%E6%94%BE%5C%22)%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.run_btn%20%3D%20QPushButton(%5C%22%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%5C%22)%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.save_btn%20%3D%20QPushButton(%5C%22%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%5C%22)%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.open_dir_btn%20%3D%20QPushButton(%5C%22%E6%89%93%E5%BC%80%E8%BE%93%E5%87%BA%E7%9B%AE%E5%BD%95%5C%22)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%23%20%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E9%80%89%E9%A1%B9%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.crop_check%20%3D%20QCheckBox(%5C%22%E8%A3%81%E5%89%AA%5C%22)%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.blur_check%20%3D%20QCheckBox(%5C%22%E6%A8%A1%E7%B3%8A%5C%22)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%23%20%E8%BE%93%E5%87%BA%E7%9B%AE%E5%BD%95%E9%80%89%E6%8B%A9%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.output_btn%20%3D%20QPushButton(%5C%22%E9%80%89%E6%8B%A9%E8%BE%93%E5%87%BA%E7%9B%AE%E5%BD%95%5C%22)%5Cn%20%20%20%20self.output_dir_label%20%3D%20QLabel(%5C%22%E5%BD%93%E5%89%8D%E8%BE%93%E5%87%BA%E7%9B%AE%E5%BD%95%3A%20%5C%22%20%2B%20self.processor.output_dir)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>def init_ui(self):
    central_widget = QWidget()
    self.setCentralWidget(central_widget)
    main_layout = QHBoxLayout(central_widget)
    left_panel = QVBoxLayout()
    self.video_label = QLabel()
    self.video_label.setAlignment(Qt.AlignCenter)
    self.video_label.setMinimumSize(640, 480)
    left_panel.addWidget(self.video_label)
    # 控制按钮
    self.select_btn = QPushButton("选择视频")
    self.play_btn = QPushButton("播放")
    self.run_btn = QPushButton("运行处理")
    self.save_btn = QPushButton("保存视频")
    self.open_dir_btn = QPushButton("打开输出目录")
    # 处理选项
    self.crop_check = QCheckBox("裁剪")
    self.blur_check = QCheckBox("模糊")
    # 输出目录选择
    self.output_btn = QPushButton("选择输出目录")
    self.output_dir_label = QLabel("当前输出目录: " + self.processor.output_dir)</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>界面布局</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>视频显示区域：QLabel 用于显示视频帧。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>控制按钮：包括“选择视频”“播放”“运行处理”“保存视频”和“打开输出目录”。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>处理选项：通过复选框控制裁剪和模糊功能。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>输出目录：支持用户自定义输出路径。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="2.2%20%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E6%92%AD%E6%94%BE%E4%B8%8E%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86">2.2 视频播放与处理</h4>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="1" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22def%20update_frame(self)%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20frame%20%3D%20self.processor.get_frame()%5Cn%20%20%20%20if%20frame%20is%20not%20None%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20if%20self.is_processing%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20processed_frame%20%3D%20self.processor.process_frame(frame)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20self.show_frame(processed_frame)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20else%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20self.show_frame(frame)%5Cn%20%20%20%20else%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20self.timer.stop()%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20self.playing%20%3D%20False%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20self.play_btn.setText(%5C%22%E6%92%AD%E6%94%BE%5C%22)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20self.processor.cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES%2C%200)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20self.is_processing%20%3D%20False%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>def update_frame(self):
    frame = self.processor.get_frame()
    if frame is not None:
        if self.is_processing:
            processed_frame = self.processor.process_frame(frame)
            self.show_frame(processed_frame)
        else:
            self.show_frame(frame)
    else:
        self.timer.stop()
        self.playing = False
        self.play_btn.setText("播放")
        self.processor.cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_FRAMES, 0)
        self.is_processing = False</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>实时播放</strong>：通过 QTimer 每 30ms 更新一帧（约 30fps）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>处理控制</strong>：当 is_processing 为 True 时，调用 process_frame 进行裁剪或模糊处理。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>帧显示</strong>：将 OpenCV 帧转换为 Qt 图像，缩放后显示在 video_label 上。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<h4 id="2.3%20%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E5%90%8E%E7%9A%84%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91">2.3 保存处理后的视频</h4>
<div class="cke_widget_wrapper cke_widget_block cke_widget_codeSnippet cke_widget_selected" tabindex="-1" role="region" contenteditable="false" aria-label="代码段 小部件" data-cke-display-name="代码段" data-cke-filter="off" data-cke-widget-id="0" data-cke-widget-wrapper="1">
<pre class="cke_widget_element highlighter-hljs" data-cke-widget-data="%7B%22lang%22%3A%22python%22%2C%22code%22%3A%22def%20save_video(self)%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20if%20not%20self.processor.processed_frames%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20QMessageBox.warning(self%2C%20%5C%22%E9%94%99%E8%AF%AF%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%E8%AF%B7%E5%85%88%E8%BF%90%E8%A1%8C%E5%A4%84%E7%90%86%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%5C%22)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20return%5Cn%20%20%20%20file_path%2C%20_%20%3D%20QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(self%2C%20%5C%22%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E6%96%87%E4%BB%B6%20(*.mp4%20*.avi)%5C%22)%5Cn%20%20%20%20if%20file_path%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20frame_width%20%3D%20int(self.processor.cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH))%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20frame_height%20%3D%20int(self.processor.cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT))%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20fps%20%3D%20self.processor.cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20fourcc%20%3D%20cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*'mp4v')%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20out%20%3D%20cv2.VideoWriter(file_path%2C%20fourcc%2C%20fps%2C%20(frame_width%2C%20frame_height))%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20for%20frame%20in%20self.processor.processed_frames%3A%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20out.write(frame)%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20out.release()%5Cn%20%20%20%20%20%20%20%20QMessageBox.information(self%2C%20%5C%22%E6%88%90%E5%8A%9F%5C%22%2C%20%5C%22%E8%A7%86%E9%A2%91%E4%BF%9D%E5%AD%98%E5%AE%8C%E6%88%90%EF%BC%81%5C%22)%22%2C%22classes%22%3Anull%7D" data-cke-widget-keep-attr="0" data-cke-widget-upcasted="1" data-widget="codeSnippet"><code>def save_video(self):
    if not self.processor.processed_frames:
        QMessageBox.warning(self, "错误", "请先运行处理视频")
        return
    file_path, _ = QFileDialog.getSaveFileName(self, "保存视频", "", "视频文件 (*.mp4 *.avi)")
    if file_path:
        frame_width = int(self.processor.cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_WIDTH))
        frame_height = int(self.processor.cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FRAME_HEIGHT))
        fps = self.processor.cap.get(cv2.CAP_PROP_FPS)
        fourcc = cv2.VideoWriter_fourcc(*'mp4v')
        out = cv2.VideoWriter(file_path, fourcc, fps, (frame_width, frame_height))
        for frame in self.processor.processed_frames:
            out.write(frame)
        out.release()
        QMessageBox.information(self, "成功", "视频保存完成！")</code></pre>
<span class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler_container"><img class="cke_reset cke_widget_drag_handler lazyload" height="15" width="15" data-cke-widget-drag-handler="1" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3687401/202508/3687401-20250822165457676-1808144825.gif"></span></div>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>视频保存</strong>：使用 OpenCV 的 VideoWriter 将处理后的帧合成为视频，保存为用户指定的文件名（支持 .mp4 和 .avi 格式）。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>参数获取</strong>：从原始视频中获取帧率、分辨率等参数，确保输出视频一致。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<hr>
<h2 id="%E6%8A%80%E6%9C%AF%E4%BA%AE%E7%82%B9">技术亮点</h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p><strong>YOLO12 模型高效性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>利用 yolo12n.pt 预训练模型，实现高效的目标检测、裁剪和模糊。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>ObjectCropper 和 ObjectBlurrer 提供便捷的 API，简化开发流程。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>实时处理</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>通过定时器和帧处理机制，实现视频流的实时处理与显示。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>支持动态切换裁剪和模糊功能，灵活性强。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>用户友好性</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>PyQt5 界面直观，支持视频预览、播放控制和结果保存。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>提供输出目录选择和文件浏览功能，方便用户管理结果。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>模块化设计</strong>：</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p>VideoProcessor 和 VideoPlayer 分离，逻辑清晰，便于维护和扩展。</p>
</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ol>
<hr>
<h2 id="%E6%80%BB%E7%BB%93">总结</h2>
<p>这个基于 YOLO12 的视频处理工具通过 Ultralytics 的 solutions 模块，实现了目标物体的自动裁剪和模糊打码功能。核心逻辑包括视频加载、帧处理（裁剪与模糊）、结果保存和用户交互，效果显著且操作简便。代码结构清晰，模块化设计使其易于扩展，适合视频处理、隐私保护等场景。</p>
<p>希望这篇文章帮助你理解 YOLO12 视频处理工具的实现逻辑！欢迎在评论区讨论或分享你的优化建议</p>
